subject: SIG/CAIQ onboarding: scheduling & initial evidence asks
messages:
From: Alex Morgan <alex.morgan@cyberdock.com>
To: sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai
Cc: security-team@cyberdock.com
Date: 2026-09-17T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: CyberDock SIG/CAIQ kickoff + availability

Hi Sergio —

Thanks for the quick intro last week. CyberDock is ready to start the formal SIG/CAIQ intake for our upcoming procurement window. We have an internal audit team (cc'd) who would like to run the questionnaire and pick a time for a 45-minute kickoff to walk CAIQ gaps and evidence handoff.

A few context items ahead of the call so you can route folks internally:
- Our scope: production API endpoints (hosted model inference), tenant isolation, and logs retention for 13 months.
- High-priority controls: logging/alerting, key management (KMS/HSM), and data residency.
- Desired deliverables: CAIQ completed draft, SOC2 evidence matrix where available, and a window for a sample log export.

Availability: 2026-09-20 or 2026-09-21 morning Pacific (9–11am PT) would work for our team.

Can you confirm who from Redwood should join (security, engineering, and a product/contract owner)? Also attaching our SIG request PDF for your triage.

Appreciate it —
Alex Morgan
Head of Security Programs, CyberDock
attachments: CyberDock_SIG_Request_20260917.pdf
From: sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai
To: Alex Morgan <alex.morgan@cyberdock.com>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-09-17T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: CyberDock SIG/CAIQ kickoff + availability

Alex —

Thanks for the details and the PDF — got it. Kimberly (Security) and Marissa (Compliance/CS lead) are looped in. Proposed attendees from Redwood:
- Kimberly Park — Security Intake lead (will own CAIQ mapping and evidence triage)
- Sergio Alvarez — Sales/eng liaison (me)
- Marissa Cole — Customer Success & evidence coordination
- Optional: one infra engineer if we need to deep dive logs/KMS.

We can do 2026-09-21 at 09:30 PT for a 45-minute slot — does that work for you and Paul (audit contact)? If yes, we will send a calendar invite with a short agenda: CAIQ scope review (15m), evidence handoff + sample log plan (20m), next steps & owners (10m).

Quick ask before the call if possible: could you indicate which CAIQ sections you want prioritized (e.g., Encryption, Logging, Access Control)? That will help Kimberly prepare an initial mapping and bring the right artifacts.

Thanks,
Sergio Alvarez
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference | sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai
From: Alex Morgan <alex.morgan@cyberdock.com>
To: sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai
Cc: security-team@cyberdock.com, Paul Nguyen <paul.nguyen@auditcorp.com>
Date: 2026-09-17T12:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: CyberDock SIG/CAIQ kickoff + availability

Perfect — 2026-09-21 09:30 PT is good for us. Calendar invite incoming. Priorities: Encryption (at-rest and in-transit), KMS/HSM key lifecycle, Logging & Alerting (retention and tamper-proofing), and Data Residency/tenant separation. If you can pre-load any CAIQ answers you have for those sections, that would speed the intake.

Also, two specific asks for the meeting:
1) We might ask for a short demo or screenshots of the log export process and an example of the log schema (no PII).
2) Clarification on whether Redwood's dedicated/private options affect where logs are stored (we have multi-region constraints).

Paul from AuditCorp will join to observe and confirm evidence requirements.

Thanks — speak soon.
Alex

On the calendar invite he included: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=cyberdock-redwood-20260921
From: kimberly_park@redwood.ai
To: Alex Morgan <alex.morgan@cyberdock.com>, sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, Paul Nguyen <paul.nguyen@auditcorp.com>
Date: 2026-09-21T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Meeting notes: SIG intake call (CAIQ focus) — 2026-09-21

Attendees:
- Alex Morgan (CyberDock, Head of Security Programs)
- Security team (CyberDock)
- Paul Nguyen (AuditCorp)
- Kimberly Park (Redwood — Security Intake lead)
- Marissa Cole (Redwood — CS/evidence)
- Sergio Alvarez (Redwood — AE)
- Ravi (infra engineer, Redwood — on the call for logs)

Summary / decisions:
- Scope confirmed: hosted API inference + customer tenant separation; logs retained 13 months; US primary data residency with EU-edge option discussed.
- Priority CAIQ sections: Encryption, KMS/HSM, Logging/Monitoring, Access Control, Incident Response.
- Redwood will provide:
  * Draft CAIQ answers for prioritized sections (preloaded to the shared Drive) — owner: Kimberly — ETA 2026-09-24
  * Sample log schema + redacted example export (S3 presigned link) — owner: Ravi — ETA 2026-09-28
  * Diagram of data flows for hosted vs dedicated/private deployments (ties to residency) — owner: Marissa — ETA 2026-09-24
  * KMS key rotation policy + HSM attestation notes (if available) — owner: Kimberly — ETA 2026-09-28
- Audit asks: Paul requested confirmation on retention enforcement (automated lifecycle policies) and whether logs are integrity-checked (digest / checksum).
- Next steps:
  1) Kimberly to drop CAIQ draft in shared drive and ping CyberDock (done: link below).
  2) Ravi to stage a redacted log export and share S3 link (credentials via secure transfer).
  3) Marissa to prepare the residency diagram and mapping between deployment modes.
  4) Sergio to follow up on contract/SLAs re: retention and region guarantees with Sales Ops.

Attachments referenced (sent after call):
- Redwood_CA IQ_coverage_matrix_draft.xlsx
- CyberDock_SIG_Request_20260917.pdf

Links shared:
- Shared CAIQ folder: https://drive.redwood.com/teams/security/CYD-CAIQ-draft
- Calendar recording (redacted): https://redwood.app/meetings/rec/20260921/CYD-kickoff

Notes on evidence format:
- We will prioritize PDFs or exported CSVs for logs; prefer checksums (SHA256) for integrity verification.
- For KMS/HSM, we will provide policy excerpts and an attestation statement if full HSM report is unavailable.

If anything is missing or you want a short follow-up deep-dive specifically on encryption or KMS, drop a note and we'll schedule a 30-minute technical session.

Thanks —
Kimberly Park
Security Intake Lead, Redwood Inference
